title: Soundness of the 3-SAT to clique reduction
statement: Let $V$ be a set of variables and let $f$ be a finite list of 3-clauses over $V$. If the conflict graph of $f$ has a clique of size equal to the number of clauses in $f$, then there is a truth assignment on $V$ that satisfies every clause of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: The conflict graph of $f$ has a clique of size $f$'s number of clauses
replaced:
Let $f$ be a 3-CNF formula consisting of $m$ clauses. If the conflict graph of $f$ has
an $m$-clique, then $f$ is satisfiable.
